title: Fayil, farashin gaskiya da kwanaki 90 na farko

say: Fayil, farashi mai kyau, da kwanaki 90 na farko.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module huɗu na Kula da Gashi da Salon Sauƙi.
Sabbin abokan ciniki ba za su iya jin yadda hannayenku suke da laushi ba, amma suna iya ganin sassa masu tsabta da lafiyayyen gefuna a cikin hotuna masu kyau.
Yi amfani da hasken rana daga taga, ko a waje a cikin inuwa.

say: Farashi yayi ƙasa da ƙasa yana ɗaya daga cikin dalilan da ya sa ƙananan salon ke gwagwarmaya. Ramin farashi ya cika diary ɗin ku amma yana barin ku gaji da karye.
Na farko, kirga kayan: gel, cream, bandeji, da gashin tsawo idan kun kawo shi.

panel.heading: Tsarin farashi mai sauƙi
items: Abubuwan da aka yi amfani da su akan waccan abokin ciniki
Babban rabo: farashin kowane wata akan abokan ciniki
Lokacin ku: lokutan sa'o'i lokutan sa'a da kuke so
Ƙara su, sannan duba farashin gida

say: Na biyu, rabon ku na sama. Ƙara farashin ku na wata-wata kamar maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta, wanke-wanke, bayanai da sufuri, da raba ta abokan ciniki da kuke tsammani.

say: Don tunawa. Kusurwoyi iri ɗaya, hasken rana da bayyanannen bango. Yarda kafin kowane hoto. Farashin yayi daidai da kayan, da rabon sama, da lokacinku. Bayar da ƙaramin zaɓi maimakon yanke farashin ku. Kuma saita maƙasudai waɗanda suka dace da sa'o'inku na gaske.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Kusurwoyi iri ɗaya, hasken rana, bangon fili
Yarda kafin kowane hoto da aikawa
Farashin = kayan + sama + lokacin ku
Bayar da ƙaramin zaɓi, ba ƙaramin farashi ba
Manufofin da suka dace da sa'o'in ku na gaske

say: Yanzu tsara fayil ɗinku, gina lissafin farashin ku, kuma ku haɗa fakitin shaidar ku. Don takardar shedar, kuna buƙatar babban dutse da aƙalla kashi 70 cikin ɗari na ƙarshe.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Shirya kuma fara fayil ɗin ku
Gina lissafin farashin ku don ayyuka huɗu
